sections.changelog: 2.31.0: URGENT - bulk law-firm import published hundreds of records in one day, and publish-notify.php's owner-ordered per-publish email hook fired once per record (~637 emails), triggering a uPress account-wide mail rate-limit (~300/day cap hit, host blocked further sending). Added a pause/resume toggle (POST justice-ops/v1/publish-notify-pause) so bulk jobs can suppress the notification without touching normal editorial publish behavior; defaults to NOT paused. 2.30.0: found live in batch-02 real-import output - 4 compound practice-area labels didn't substring-match their obvious existing term, leaving those firms with zero practice-area terms. Added exact aliases.
